rows.ARS:
White, near white or white blend Floribunda.
Exhibition name: Nina Nadine
rows.Origin:
Bred by Gordon Wilson Kirkham (United Kingdom, 2002).
Introduced in United Kingdom by C & K Jones in 2002 as 'Nina Nadine'.
rows.Bloom: Cream, pink edges. Full (26-40 petals), cluster-flowered, in small clusters bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Tall, bushy. Glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 4' (120cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden. Vigorous. Remove spent blooms to encourage re-bloom. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
